metadata.note: Relayed variant of `safenet/safenet_stake.json`: the same stake of 12,600 SAFE against an existing allowance, which is secure on its own, but with a refund attached. `gasPrice` is 1 with USDC as `gasToken` and `baseGas` of 900,000,000,000, so per § 2.18 of the Safenet Charter the Safe will pay `(gasUsed + baseGas) * gasPrice`, i.e. about 900,000 USDC, to `refundReceiver`, an address with no prior interaction with the Safe. The refund, not the stake, is the effect of this transaction: it is a transfer of the Safe's funds to an untrusted receiver, orders of magnitude beyond any plausible gas reimbursement. A verdict must consider the relaying parameters even when the primary call is one that would otherwise be considered secure.
